name: Oltiariq

queries.query: Oltiariq Uzbekistan official cadastral parcel map cadastre GIS API; Uzbekistan official cadastral map Oltiariq Fergana parcel
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Uzbekistan's National Geoinformation Portal at open.ngis.uz, operated by the Cadastre Agency. The indexed official portal describes coordinate and cadastral-number search and an Esri-backed map. Official Digital Government material describes open real-estate-register information through this portal. No usable anonymous parcel feature response was obtained.
